Settings: Set the maximum amount of time that can be recorded into the audio buffer. New settings only take effect when recording is triggered with a black MIDI note.
Set the maximum number of concurrent retrigger voices before voice stealing kicks in.

• On - The oldest retrigger voice will be stolen.
  • Off - Ignore any new triggers until a voice is available.
Adds a small fade in to prevent audible clicks when playing the buffer audio.
Adds a small fade out to prevent audible clicks when playing the buffer audio.
